title: Economic Survey On Agriculture
definition: The Economic Survey of Agriculture is an exhaustive annual flagship document presented by the Ministry of Finance, Government of India, detailing the performance, structural shifts, policy interventions, challenges, and medium-term outlook of the primary sector. It serves as the official macroeconomic diagnostic report on Indian agriculture, allied sectors, food security, capital formation, and rural economy.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC CSE Prelims (direct data questions on GVA share, credit growth, institutional schemes, food grain production) and Mains GS Paper 3 (Agriculture: Cropping patterns, MSP, subsidies, e-NAM, digital agriculture, institutional credit, and supply chain management).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Economic Survey On Agriculture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of Indian Economy and National Income Accounting (GDP vs GVA)
Fundamental knowledge of Indian agriculture sectors (Crops, Livestock, Fisheries, Forestry)
